info.title: API.SH: Getty Images
info.description: The Getty Images API from API.SH: public Getty Images data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Getty Images editorial event: `event` (id, name, date, local start date, editorial products, url) and its photos (the same item fields as the search route), with sort and orientation. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/getty-images-event

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The event id or its gettyimages.com event link, e.g. `776578878`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: `best` (best match), `mostpopular` (the site's default), `newest` or `oldest`.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: horizontal, vertical, square, panoramichorizontal, panoramicvertical; comma separated for several.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Editorial events on Getty Images (news, sport, entertainment shoots) matching keywords: the site's search grouped by event. Each event: `id`, `name`, `date`, `photo_count`, `url`, `editorial_products` and `cover` (the lead photo). Accepts the editorial filters of the search route (sort, orientation, editorial_product, collection, photographer, recency, end_date and the people filters). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page; open an event with `/getty-images/v1/event`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/getty-images-events

get.summary: Getty Images image or video details
get.description:
One Getty Images image or video: title, caption, family, licence type and allowed use, release, photographer and contributor, collection, credit, location, dates, full-size dimensions, every size on sale (pixels, inches, dpi, file size; videos: format, frame rate, codec), keywords with their type and parent, categories, event ids, preview image or video, key frames (videos) and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/getty-images-image

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The image or video id or its gettyimages.com link, e.g. `1952253409`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Getty Images image and video search
get.description:
Images or videos on Getty Images (gettyimages.com, stock and editorial photos and footage) for keywords and every filter of the site's search page: family (creative or editorial), sort, orientation, media type, age and number of people, composition, ethnicity, technique, video viewpoint, editorial product, collection, photographer, date added, end date, licence and nudity. Each item: `id`, `title`, `caption`, `asset_type`, `family`, `media_type`, `license_type`, `url`, `thumbnail`, `preview_video` and `clip_length` (videos), `width`, `height`, `orientation`, `photographer`, `collection`, `collection_code`, `date_created`, `event` (editorial), `editorial_products`, `colors` and `raw`. Also `total`, `related_searches` and `applied_filters`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/getty-images-search

get.description:
Search suggestions for what was typed, as the Getty Images search box shows them, for images or videos and a content family.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/getty-images-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text typed so far, e.g. `eiff`.

parameters.name: asset_type
parameters.description: `image` (default) or `video`.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Content family: `all` (default), `creative` (stock) or `editorial` (news, sport, entertainment, archival).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language code (default `en-us`), e.g. `en-gb`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
